batting.dismissal: c N Saini b RJ Harris

batting.dismissal: c RJ Harris b PP Chawla

batting.name: AL Menaria
batting.dismissal: c Gurkeerat Singh b PP Chawla

batting.name: BJ Hodge
batting.dismissal: c SE Marsh b RJ Harris

batting.name: STR Binny
batting.dismissal: c SE Marsh b RJ Harris

batting.name: Mandeep Singh
batting.dismissal: c SK Trivedi b SR Watson

batting.dismissal: c BJ Hodge b SK Trivedi

batting.name: RJ Harris
batting.dismissal: c J Botha b SW Tait

balls.text: short ball, tries to pull it away and gets only a top-edge, goes towards mid-on, Marsh ran forward to take another good catch!
length ball, driven but straight to the covers for a single, that will bring Stuart Binny on strike for the last ball

out, caught at wide long-on, superb catch there from Marsh, full-toss, Hodge seemed to have got bat on it and smoked it to the wide long-on region, the fielder ran to his right and plucked off a diving catch.
pitched right up and that has been smacked back over the bowler for another four! 10 off three balls after 16 from the previous over.
length ball and it has gone high in the air, but it has also taken the distance, goes over long-on for a six, 93 metres!
yorker, a perfect one in the hindsight, missed by Hodge and goes through to the keeper
slower one, but sits up as a full-toss outside the off stump and Botha bends his front foot forward and drives it gracefully through the extra-cover region for a four!
driven through the covers for a single, good batting from the two overseas batsmen here
full-toss out the off stump, flicks it to the deep mid-wicket region for a single and a misfield allows them to come back for the second.
slow ball, rather slow, went for a heave and missed judging the pace of the ball, goes through to the keeper
tries to lap sweep it over short fine-leg, just falling short of Harris at that position and they are able to come back for the second thanks to the misfield
pitched right up to the bat and Hodge has cleared the long-off fielder with much ease, smacked away for a six!
beamer, goes at chest height for Hodge, the bowler slips after bowling it, gets up and apologises to the batsman
another one down the leg side, flicked away to fine-leg for a single, to bring up their 150
full-toss on the pads, probably because the off-side field is difficult to bowl at, he tries to flick it away, gets it away to the deep fielder for a single only
on the pads yet again and the square-leg fielder, Mahmood misfields a very simple one, instead of one they get two here.
once again on the pads, the batsman misses this time, but they get a leg-bye
goes on to the back foot and finds the gap between mid-on and mid-wicket, both of whom were within the circle, four for the Aussie
length ball, wanted to go for the drive but he gets some movement away from the bat and beats the batsman
shorter ball yet again, and it has been cut away over point for a four! Good end to the over.
length ball, Botha goes on to his back foot, drives it back to the bowler.
opens the face of the bat, plays it to point and they are off for a single
short from Mahmood and Botha has pulled it away to deep square-leg for a single
outside the off stump, opens the face of the bat, played to third-man for a single
short of good length, on the back foot, pushes to the off side for a single
gone, caught! Chawla has eked out his second wicket, pitched right up, tried to heave it away and can only hit it to deep mid-wicket for the fielder to take a simple catch
pitched up to the bat, on the leg stump, gets an inside edge to the fine-leg and they easily get a second
pitched right up, slogged away, but hits the non-striker, goes to the covers and they get a single
quicker, does not flight it too much and Menaria punches it through the covers for a single
flat and short and cut away by Hodge, they take two and by the time Mandeep Singh can throw it back, they come back for the third too!
outside the off stump, punched to the off side to the fielder

pulled and dropped! Awana did everything possible to get the better of Menaria and he was struggling with the bouncer throughout, he got the pull going for a change but it flew to Mandeep Singh at deep square-leg, dropped
opens the face of the bat, guides him down to the third-man for a single
good length, outside the off stump, driven on the up to long-off for a single
pitched up to the bat, driven to wide mid-on for a single
moves in his crease, wants to pull it away but does not get the middle of the bat, and they take a single
on the off stump, punched off the back foot into the covers and they are off for a single
another bouncer, this time Menaria ducks under it and the umpire does not call it a wide, looked a tad down the leg side
bouncer, Menaria struggled to sway away from it! The Punjab side seems to have realised that he isn't at his best against the shorter one
short of length, played away to the leg side for a single. Menaria wanted the second but Hodge was having none of it
outside the off stump, driven on the up, to deep cover for a single
edged and caught at third-man! It was outside the off stump, Dravid went for a drive through the covers, gets the outside edge and it flies to the third-man fence, they have lost their third
outside the off stump, opens the face of the bat to third-man for a single
he attempts another of those cut shots, but fails to latch on to it, and the edge goes on the bounce to the long-off fielder
too much of the bouncer stuff, this time the batsman was waiting on the back foot and a yorker would have been a better idea, lets it go
down the wicket and attempts to smack it, but the pace is too hot to handle for the left-hander
tries to flay it away, but the bounce beats him, goes through to the wicket-keeper
slower one from Awana and that is read well, goes to his back foot, pulls it away, the fielder at deep square-leg runs to his right to field it
short of length, Dravid moves away to the leg side, punched through the covers for a single
opens the face of the bat and it goes to the third-man region for a single
punched back to the bowler, end of a good over for RR
quicker from Chawla, pushed to the off side and they are off for a quick one
shorter ball from Chawla and it has been smacked over the mid-wicket fence for a six!
down the ground and for a six, sends the camera man scurrying for cover! Pitched right up to the bat, and it has been smoked down the ground!
pitched fuller, outside the off stump, driven to long-off for a single
googly, coming into the bat, tries to cut it, but hits the boot
short ball, that is flicked away to deep fine-leg for a single, Dravid's quickly moved on to 44.
tries to pull it away, the pace is too hot to handle, it loops up and almost goes to hand at square-leg
good length ball, goes on to the back foot to try and work it through the leg side but it hurries on to him
on the off stump, punched to the off side for no run
good length, but too close to the bat to cut, he attempts that shot and misses
edged and drops short of the wicket-keeper, stops it on the bounce
driven back, pitched up and no run for Dravid this time
another one short and that is probably the shot that Watson wanted to play, drilled through wide long-off for another boundary
cut away for a single
pitched right up to the bat and drilled to the long-on fielder for a single
shorter, cut away to the point for a single
pitched right up to the bat, driven to long-on for a single
jagging back into the batsman, wanted to flick it away, missed, hits his thigh-pad and that is the end of the over
on the middle stump and defended back to the bowler
Oh what a shot! Injured or not, outside the off stump and the ball has been gracefully cut through the point region for a four!

short, bouncer and it has hit Dravid hard, who is in a bit of a pain. It was not a quick bouncer and he was through the shot before it arrived and he missed, hits him flush on the chest. An ouch moment!
another one which is short and cut away to deep cover for a single
short and wide and that has been spanked through the point region for a four, boundary off the first ball he faces
cut away to the sweeper for an easy single, and then there is a misfield which allows them to go for the second

caught and gone at long-off! Chawla has stuck, again a shorter one, Watson went for a forehand shot over the long-off boundary but missed timing it too well, it went to wide long-off where Harris dived and pulled off a beauty.
this was pushed quicker, pitched up and Watson has smoked him over long-on for a six!
another short ball from Chawla, his third and that is pulled to long-on for a single
short, punched to extra-cover but not for runs
short ball and that has kept rather low outside the off stump, which is a good thing because Watson mistimes the stroke and it goes to long-on
on the middle, pushes the batsman back and he defends it back into the off side
on the off stump, pushed into the covers and goes to the fielder
tries for another cut, the ball bounces more than he expected and the swing beats him too
pulled away this time and that is gone away for a four, over mid-wicket, pulling it in front of the square-leg
outside the off stump, good length, punched towards mid-off, the fielder at extra cover runs quickly and stops the run
extra bounce, short of length and moving away as well, misses the cut shot
straight driven, back to the bowler and that beats both, the bowler and the diving fielder at mid-on for a four! This is some excellent stroke-making from both the batsmen
shot, six! That was a lot of pace and a good length ball, it has been deposited into the stands behind long-on for maximum!
lofted over mid-on and for a four! That was pitched right up to the bat, Watson hits it through the line, over the fielder who was up in the circle.
bouncer from Awana, wide called by the umpire, Watson was hurried into his evasive action.
pushed away off the pads to deep square-leg, the fielder was up at short fine-leg but he drive it squarer than that
good length, on his pads, flicked away to deep square-leg and the batsmen are able to run through for a couple
short of good length, played away to the third-man region for a single

this is a stunning start from Rajasthan, difficult to reconcile with the fact that Dravid's hitting so many to the fence, but all have been some superb cricket shots, driven through the covers for a four!
driven through the extra-cover region for four, that has beaten the fielder at mid-off rather easily.
punched away to the mid-off for a single
slower one from PK, angling into the batsman, tries to flick it away and hits the pad, trudges away for a single.
in-swinger, Watson opens the face of the bat and plays it down to third-man for a single
four fours in a row, short from Praveen Kumar, pulled away to mid-wicket for another four!
three in a row, on driven, this time to the left of the square-leg fielder and it easily beats the deep square-leg fielder! Amazing shot-making, pleasing to the eye!
and follows it up with a cover drive, half volley and sent on its way to the fence for a four!
clipped away classically, through square-leg for a four, the fielder within the circle dived to his right but the batsman had found the gap
on the off stump, good length, punched back to the bowler
on the pads yet again, Dravid wants to play his favourite on-drive through mid-wicket, gets an inside edge to square-leg for a couple
on his pads and that has been flicked away to fine-leg, off the middle of the bat but one bounce to the fielder, PK
that nearly bowled Dravid, he came forward to force the good length ball on the leg side and was beaten between bat and body
played off the pads through midwicket
inswing into the right-hander and the ball swung on to the middle of Watson's bat, he came forward and lofted the full ball flat over the umpire's head
Harris moves to his left at short fine leg and dives to cut off a flick from Dravid, that was four if it beat him
Dravid reaches out for a wide ball and mis-times the cut to point
short of a length outside off, Watson steers to third man
good length outside off, driven on the front foot towards cover
played from the crease on the leg side
driven on the front foot to mid-off
the ball pitches on a good length and seams away, Watson moves forward and lets it go

caught behind! Oddly the keeper did not go up immediately. Harris dug the ball in short outside off and Rahane attempted to cut it, he top edged it to Yagnik. Dravid and Rahane average more than 50 for the first wicket this season, not today. That ball bounced sharply and seamed away
a full ball swings away from the right-hander outside off stump, Rahane reaches for it and threads the square drive through the gap between two fielders in the point region
played off the back foot towards midwicket
Rahane moves towards the off and tries to force the ball on the leg side, he gets beaten
length ball outside off stump, Rahane stays in his crease and punches to cover
swings into the right-hander from just outside off, Rahane gets behind the line and defends
that's full and down leg side, first extra of the night
Dravid moves forward and runs as soon as he pushes the ball towards mid-on
not as much swing tonight, good length outside off, Dravid drives to cover
full-toss, down the leg-side, tapped away for a single and that is the end of the game, with Rajasthan winning by 43 runs
goes for a pull, misses, and it goes through to the wicket-keeper
down the leg side and it is left alone for a wide
full-toss and cracked through the point region for a four!
another short one from Watson and this goes over his shoulder, the second one that goes over his shoulder, no-ball given
short ball, Nayar waited for the ball and pulled it away to the deep square-leg for a one-bounce single
another short ball, but it was a slower one, went on the back foot, tapped it to the leg side for a single
bouncer and he ducks under it
another full ball on the off stump, gets an outside edge to the point region for a single
quick yorker and this time he tries to whip it away, gets a bit of an inside edge for a single
yorker length once again but PK has no back-lift, he defends it back to the bowler
yorker on the leg stump, Nayar has moved to the off, flicks it away to the deep square-leg for a single
pitched right up to the bat, Harris hits it in the air, goes to the long-on fielder for a simple catch. They were checking for the no-ball, both the front and back foot, given out!
slower one from Tait, Harris flicks it away to the deep square-leg region and they come back for the second
another good yorker, drifting into the base of leg stump, digs it out and they are off for a run
good length ball, played away to the mid-wicket fielder but they are not able to get a run. Only four so far.
bouncer first up from Harris, ducks under it and lets it go.
bowled him, yorker length, and the stump lies flat on the ground. Chawla wanted to drive it, played an aggressive stroke but missed it and Watson sneaks through his defence
cut away and powerfully at that through the point region for a four!
outside the off stump, pitched up, driven by Chawla but straight to the fielder at covers
pitched up to Chawla, who hits it over to long-off for a single.
goes down the pitch, hits it through mid-wicket for a single, the required rate is 20 an over!
full-toss on his pads, driven through the mid-wicket for a couple of runs for Nayar.
caught this time, finally a catch is taken, tries to sweep it away, the top edge goes high in the air and the bowler called it loud, clear and early, and then caught it well.
slower from Botha, but he sweeps it away yet again and beats the fielder at mid-wicket, the fielder was moved straighter and he beats him again
full-toss and that has been carted over mid-wicket for a four
short of good length, tries to pull it away, slower one, the pull goes to the deep mid-wicket for a single
short of good length, outside the off stump, driven to the sweeper region for a single
another hoick, another drop! Two times in the same over and that is poor fielding. Wanted to hoick it away, goes high in the air off the top edge and the keeper drops it!
outside the off stump, slower, good length, punched to long-off for a single
pitched right up to the batsman, driven to long-off for a single
top edged and dropped by Chavan! He tried to slog it away, but the ball came out very slow, got a lot of elevation but the fielder at fine-leg floors it
there is still some swing, the ball pitched on the middle and swung in, played to long-on for a single
slower one and bowled, Mahmood was going for another heave over the mid-wicket region but he misses it, too early into the stroke
slower and pulled away by the batsman, but it goes on the bounce to deep mid-wicket region for a single
outside the off stump, swinging away and he went for a swing over mid-wicket, gets the toe end of the bat
shorter, slower from Binny, pulled away but straight to the fielder for a single
goes for a heave, good length ball and the edge goes to the third-man for a four.
goes outside the leg stump, wanted to flick it away, but again hits the pad.
goes down the pitch and wanted to drive, but held back, hits the pad
slower and he tries his sweep again, but can only get it away to square-leg for a run
swept it away for a couple of runs to fine-leg
driven and hits the non-striker and they still get a single
gone up in the air and dropped! Brad Hodge has dropped a simple catch there, Mahmood was beaten by the flight and it went straight to the fielder, who dropped it.
good length ball, quick and defended to the off side for a single
middle stump, tries to play it through the leg side, bit of swing, leading edge to the point fielder
down the leg side and quick, but misses the batsman and it is wide
outside the off stump, swinging away, digs out the fuller ball to third-man for a single
outside the off stump, full yet again and driven to the point region.
bowls fuller, 143.4 km/hr, on the back foot and defended by Mahmood to the covers
on the middle stump, gets a bit of a leading edge to long-on for a single
that has been tonked into the stands by Mahmood, fuller, wider and the batsman went after the ball, deposited into the stands for a six
another one that seems to stop on the batsman, gets a leading edge over the bowler's head
slower ball, had Mahmood checking his shot, defended on the off side and they get a quick single this time
opens the face of the bat, to the third-man for a single
short of length, flicked to mid-wicket, wanted a single but sent back by the batsman, a direct hit would have seen Mahmood out
on his pads, drives it to deep square-leg for a single, only three off the over and the required-rate climbs up to more than 12
full-toss and driven down the ground for a single
this time drives it to Rahane at mid-wicket, at the edge of the circle, went for a single, a direct hit at non-striker's end would have been interesting.
slower, bit more air, comes out and defends on the front foot
pitched right up to the batsman yet again, driven to mid-wicket
pitched up and driven to mid-wicket

on his pads, tries to flick it, goes straight to short fine-leg, went for a single, but the non-striker did not want to go for it, by the time Mahmood got back, the throw had come in at his end. Missed the stumps though.
short of good length, goes on to the back foot, defends it to the off side
slower outside the off stump, swinging away and misses the outside edge
pulled away over the wicket-keeper for a four! That was a short ball and the batsman tried to hook it, gets the top-edge through to the fence
shorter outside the off stump, punched to the leg side for a single
on the middle, slower, pushed it into the covers but for nothing
short of good length, pushed it back to the bowler
goes down the leg side, Mahmood tried to flick it, he missed it, and the keeper removed the bails quickly, but the umpire gives it not-out.
pitched up, driven to the long-on for a single
goes down the pitch and has yorked himself here, bowled! Botha pushed it quicker, Marsh looked to be a tad fidgety because of the increasing required-rate and is bowled
again on the pads, tries to tap it away but gets no bat on it, they are off for a leg-bye
straighter one, quicker one, bounce and beats the outside edge, bit of an appeal
spin and bounce for Botha, but down the leg side and Mahmood lets it go
inswinging delivery, still a bit of deviation on this pitch, defends somewhat awkwardly, back to the bowler
outside the off stump, swinging away from the bat, punched away to the off side for a single, off the mark is Mahmood
flicked away to the square-leg for a single
tries to pull it away and caught! Failed to control the shot, gets the pull going, bottom of the bat and Hodge takes a superb catch sliding forward
incoming ball this one, defended off the back foot, back to the bowler for no run
for the third time, Hussey has been squared up, this off the bowling of Trivedi, gets the edge, goes through slips for four!
goes down the track and drives to long-on, it was more of a push and it goes through to the fielder, Botha who fielded well and threw it back, but while doing so the foot hit the boundary.
pitched up this time, but way down the leg side, he has flicked it away rather fine and it goes to the fence
shot, six! He has been batting well against the shorter ball this over, two of them have disappeared, he has spanked it away over mid-wicket for six
flighted up, on the legs, he misses the drive this time
a tad short this time and he swivels  back and spanks it over mid-wicket for a four!
on his pads, drilled to mid-wicket, fielded well by Watson
pitched up on the off side this time, driven to the mid-off region and that ends a wicket-taking over
yorker length, 148 km/hr, pitched up and squares him up again, a bit of swing.
squares him up, leading edge and that could have gone to hands in the covers! Instead, it goes in the gap and tell you what, the edge has gone for four!
quick on his pads again, and he tries to flick it away, gets a leading edge back to the bowler, an easy catch spooned back to the bowler there.
way down the leg side and thankfully it was a fuller ball which allowed the wicket-keeper a favourable bounce, only a single run off the wide
good length ball, opens the face of the ball, plays it away to the third-man for a single
outside the off stump, yorker-length, tries to drill it through the off side but goes through to the wicket-keeper
yorker length ball, tries to flick it away but back to the bowler
on his pads, flicked away by Marsh and there is a single to square-leg
goes down the pitch, takes it on the full and drives it to long-on for a single
round the wicket, drifting into the batsman, guided through square-leg for a single
pitched right up to the bat, tries to sweep it, misses and there is an appeal, not-out given
on the middle stump, pushed to the deep mid-wicket for a single
outside the off stump, dabbed to the point region but no run for the batsman
the boundaries make Watson change his line to outside the leg-stump, and a tickle there would have got him a four, misses and it goes to the keeper
pitched up this time, brings his front foot out and spanks him over the bowler for a four!
and now, this one swings in to the left-hander instead of deviating outside! Beats his Aussie teammate and the hits the pads and lobs up to the wicket-keeper
outside edge and poor effort from Tait at third-man allows it to roll over for a four. The outside edge went on the bounce to Hodge in the slips, misfielded there as well!
round the wicket, pitches and looks like it will angle in, instead, it leaves the batsman and beats the outside edge.
good length on the middle, punched down to mid-off and they are off for a quick single
short ball from Tait and Marsh tries to pull it away, gets into position quickly and hits well too, but straight to square-leg
pitched up to Marsh outside the off stump, drives it to mid-off but it goes straight to the fielder.
short of length, 146.3 km/hr, flicked away to fine-leg for a single
goes back to bowling the good length, swinging in and the outside the edge gets Marsh a single to third-man
bouncer on the leg-stump, ducks under it and it is the second successive wide of the over
width outside the off stump, Marsh went for the cut, missed it but it was too far wide from the bat for the umpire to not call it a wide!
first ball this season from Tait, yorker length, swinging in and Marsh does well to get his bat in the way!
short of good length, going straight on, wanted to punch it through the covers but missed the inside edge of the bat
pitched up yet again, swinging slightly away and hit to point, that is five dots now
middle stump, length ball, defends on the back foot, back to the bowler

short ball, pulled away but straight to the fielder at mid-on! Mandeep Singh is an in-form player and he had hit a six last over, one got the feeling he was trying to manufacture shots and he has perished to a catch to mid-on.
swings at it, good length ball outside the off stump and misses. I think he expected it to swing, but it did not
outside the off stump, pitched up and it swings away from the bat, goes to the covers but straight to the fielder
outside the off stump, pitched up too, driven to mid-off
on to his back foot, nudged away for a single to mid-wicket
short ball from the spinner and he was quickly on to the back foot, pulled away over long-on for a six! What a shot this early!
on the pads of the right hander too, driven to square-leg but not for runs
on his pads yet again, this time he drives it to deep square-leg for a single
on his pads, driven to square-leg for no run
